displayName.zh-CN: D剪 · AI 视频剪辑工作台

description.zh-CN: 人与 AI 同时剪同一条时间线：面板手动剪辑与 AI 工具实时同步，用户的每次修改都会作为事件告诉 AI；支持转场、关键帧、字幕样式、画中画、配乐闪避，一键出片。
description.en-US: You and the AI edit one timeline together: manual edits in the panel and AI tool calls stay in sync, and every user edit is reported to the model as an event. Transitions, keyframes, styled captions, picture-in-picture, music ducking and one-click export.
